name: AfriDoctor Messenger
author: afridoctor

sections.description:
AfriDoctor Messenger lets your website visitors message you directly through the AfriDoctor messaging platform: email verification, sign-in/sign-up, and appointment booking, exactly as on your AfriDoctor profile.

This plugin only displays your chat bubble; no data from your website is sent to AfriDoctor beyond the messages exchanged inside the bubble itself.

For security reasons, the widget only displays if this website’s domain has been explicitly authorized in your AfriDoctor account (messaging section) — see step 4 of the installation instructions.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the afridoctor-messenger folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it directly via “Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin” with the .zip file provided by AfriDoctor.
  2. Activate the plugin from the WordPress “Plugins” menu.
  3. Go to “Settings > AfriDoctor Messenger”. Paste your AfriDoctor practitioner ID (available in your AfriDoctor account, messaging section) and save.
  4. In your AfriDoctor account, messaging section, enter this website’s domain name in the “Allowed domain” field — without this step, the widget stays invisible.
  5. The chat bubble appears automatically on every page of your website.
sections.faq:
Where do I find my practitioner ID?

In your AfriDoctor account, where you enable messaging for your account.

The bubble does not appear after activation?

Check that the practitioner ID is set under “Settings > AfriDoctor Messenger”, and that this website’s domain has been entered in your AfriDoctor account (messaging section, “Allowed domain” field).
